verdict.rationale: The story applies, since a law firm can reasonably publish how it uses AI in client service. Nothing in the evidence pack describes Osborne Clarke's own AI tools, AI-use policies or AI-practice products. The investor-readiness online tool, cap table downloads and UPC decision tracker are non-AI client resources, and the probes found no llms.txt or API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the firm publishes how it uses AI in client service — named tools, policies, or AI-practice products of its own — beyond a marketing mention
